sourced_facts.fact: Aehr Test Systems reported FY2020 (fiscal year ended 2020-05-31) net sales of $22,291 thousand (~$22.3M) and net loss attributable to common shareholders of $(2,802) thousand (~-$2.8M); non-GAAP net loss for the year was ~$27 thousand.

Q4 FY2020 (three months ended 2020-05-31): net sales $3,773 thousand; net loss attributable to common shareholders $(2,885) thousand; non-GAAP net loss ~$720 thousand; weighted-average diluted shares 23,060 thousand (FY weighted diluted shares 22,882 thousand).
Balance sheet at 2020-05-31: cash and cash equivalents $5,433 thousand; current portion of long-term debt $653 thousand; long-term debt $1,026 thousand.
Backlog as of 2020-05-31 was $2.5 million, down from $7.5 million a year earlier.
FY2021 outlook (fiscal year ending 2021-05-31): the Company expects full-year total revenue between $25 million and $28 million, versus FY2020 net sales of $22.3 million.

The release cites new design-win and initial orders for FOX-family wafer-level test and burn-in systems: an initial order from a major silicon photonics customer, an initial order from the world's largest OSAT for FOX-P products, and initial orders from a leading semiconductor device supplier for a FOX multi-wafer system that the release ties to silicon carbide. No dollar amount is disclosed. Consumables (WaferPak contactors and DiePak carriers) were reported as about 48% of FY2020 revenue (single reading, not checked against the table).

AEHR's nominal close on the freeze date, 2020-07-17, was $2.09 (open 2.04, high 2.18, low 1.88, volume 681,700). Adjusted close equals close, consistent with no later split adjustments. This is a daily bar read today, not an archived data snapshot. No prices after the freeze date were used.

Derived approximate market capitalization at the freeze date: $2.09 close × 23.06M Q4 weighted-average diluted shares ≈ $48.2M. This is approximate because it uses weighted shares rather than shares outstanding.
